issue.body:
## Goal

Migrate the retry override key from `retries` to `max_retries`. `max_retries` must override the default, the legacy `retries` key must no longer override it, and the tests must cover the new key, legacy-key behavior, and the default.

## Scope

Modify only `src/settings.py` and `tests/test_settings.py`.
issue.title: [Eval] Migrate retry override to max_retries
